n: 4-Series™ DIN Rail Control System for Crestron Home® OS (DIN-AP4-R)
d: DIN-AP4-R 4-Series™ DIN Rail Control System for Crestron Home® OS

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps, auto‑switching, auto‑negotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, industry-standard TCP/IP stack, UDP/IP, CIP, DHCP, SSL, TLS, SSH, SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), FIPS 140-2 compliant encryption,IPv4

specs.label: USB
specs.value: Supports USB mass storage class devices via the bottom panel USB 2.0 host port, supports computer console via the front panel USB 2.0 device port

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: Supports 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.2 MHz or serial TTL/RS-232 (0–5V) up to 115.2k baud

specs.label: Memory Card
specs.value: Supports microSD® cards up to 32 GB (4 GB included)

specs.label: External Storage
specs.value: Supports USB storage devices up to 1 TB

specs.label: Power Source Options
specs.value: Power supply (sold separately) or PoE (Power over Ethernet)

specs.label: Power over Ethernet
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 1 (802.3af compatible) Class 0 (12.95W) PoE Powered Device

specs.label: Available Cresnet Power
specs.value: 2.5 W maximum when powered via PoE; 20 W maximum when powered via DIN‑PWS30‑277
